Is any hidden plan's truth stated before its reveal?
How long does a line of play take to its reply (p50, p95), which call kinds take the time, and how much of it is the 2.5 s the table takes with the model answering at once?
What does a line of play cost the module, by call kind — which kinds write a cache nothing reads, and what does the Chronicle scribe cost a session?
Does any prompt grow with the run (characters per action, by call kind)?
Do the sessions' opening and closing scenes repeat each other by content (GALLEY-VIGNETTE-REPEATS)?

prices.notes: Standard rates, read from Anthropic's price list on the date above. A cache write is charged at 1.25 times input when it is kept five minutes and twice input when it is kept an hour, by the split the response reports (lib/budget.mjs); a write that does not say is priced as an hour's. Haiku 5.5 costs five times these rates on a prompt over 100,000 tokens; the module's prompts are a few thousand.
